sources.title: GitHub - wtcherr/lunar-lander-dqn: DQN Solution for LunarLander-v3 ...
sources.snippet: The goal of this project is to train an agent using the DQN algorithm to land a spacecraft safely on a designated landing pad in the "LunarLander-v3" environment. The environment is a classic control problem based on Box2D physics, where the agent must optimize its thrusters to achieve a stable landing.
